name: Blow Reading
description: Read the shape of a coming blow so the draw can be set to take its heaviest part.

name: Taken Edge
description: Take the edge of a soul strike into the user and leave only its blunt remainder.

name: Kept Residue
description: Keep the residue of a turned blow as soul force added to the reserve.

name: Backstep Draw
description: Step back from a blow and draw its spent force into the body as it passes.

name: Inverted Strike
description: Turn a soul strike inward and take part of its force and send the rest back at the striker.

name: Drained Reply
description: Answer a soul blow with a jolt made of the force just drawn from it.

name: Slow Intake
description: Let force seep into the cistern from a hostile flow at the rate the soul can hold.

name: Cistern Lock
description: Lock the mouth of the cistern so a probing soul cannot pull drawn force back out.

name: Cistern Level
description: Read the level of the cistern and the pressure of the force now sitting in it.

name: Seeping Hold
description: Hold a seeping draw on a target's soul that wears its force down.

name: Measured Release
description: Open the cistern a measured amount and loose that force as one jolt.

name: Spillway Burst
description: Let a full cistern overflow in a ring so every soul close to the user feels the burst.

name: Cleansing Siphon
description: Draw erosion and taint out of the user's own soul and convert them into plain soul force.

name: Reserve Heat
description: Read the heat of the reserve and judge how much more draw it can take before it flares.

name: Lit Draw
description: Light the reserve with a draw of hostile force so the next technique carries more weight.

name: Kindling Guard
description: Feed the reserve into a guard that burns away the edge of a mental push.

name: Rekindle
description: Rekindle a failing soul reserve from the last of a drawn force.

name: Bright Pull
description: Pull the brightness from a target's gathered technique so it comes out dim.

name: Flare Release
description: Flare the reserve in one hot jolt at a target's soul.

name: Steady Burn
description: Keep the reserve burning at an even heat so every technique of the user hits harder for a time.

name: Scorching Return
description: Return drawn force as a hot lance that passes through a soul's guard.

name: Ash Cleanse
description: Burn a soul taint to ash in the reserve and leave the soul clear of it.

name: Vapour Reading
description: Read the vapour of soul force that rises from a hostile technique as it is drawn.

name: Coarse Distillate
description: Run a draw through a coarse still to leave a thin distillate of clean soul force.

name: Fine Condense
description: Condense drawn force again and again until only the purest part remains in the reserve.

name: Retort Guard
description: Close a retort of soul force round the self that turns a mental push into clean vapour.

name: Cooling Pull
description: Cool a target's gathered force by drawing off its heat so the technique slackens.

name: Drip Strike
description: Let a single concentrated drop of distillate fall as a sharp jolt into a soul.

name: Alembic Turn
description: Turn a draw through the alembic so a single hostile blow feeds the reserve far beyond its weight.

name: Pure Rinse
description: Run a poisoned soul through the still and rinse the poison out as dark vapour.

name: Pooled Gauge
description: Gauge how much force the shared pool holds and how fast it fills.

name: Shared Siphon
description: Siphon force from a hostile source into a pool shared with a nearby ally so both are steadied.

name: Pool Cover
description: Spread a cover of soul force over the pool and the ally beside it against a mental push.

name: Narrow Channel
description: Cut a narrow channel across a foe's gathering force and drain it before it forms.

name: Wide Draw
description: Spread a wide draw over several hostile sources at once and pool all of their force.

name: Flooded Return
description: Flood the pooled force back at the souls of everyone who struck at the pool.
